Glyph_µ=⟨Identity,Program,Phases,Topology,LearnedState⟩; µ(b,θ,g) K'UHUL executable address; b=semantic address, θ=face/phase, g=geometry; Q_n□C_6 coordinate interpretation; Glyph:Structure→Structure' higher-order opcode; codex→unfold→faces→fold computation law.

questions.question: What is a K'UHUL glyph-opcode and how does it differ from an x86 opcode?
questions.expected_key: Glyph Structure to Structure prime or Program to Program prime not ADD a b operand is graph pattern fold relation or program higher-order opcode not scalar register

questions.question: What is the codex computation law?
questions.expected_key: codex unfold faces glyph relationships interpretation fold becomes Program Ana F_Q WCR Cata C_Q unfold=Ana faces=C6 phases relationships=WCR fold=Cata

questions.expected_key: glyph symbolic program identity the named thing micronaut executable instance the running thing same program two views symbolic addressing versus execution container

questions.question: Why is Q_n □ C_6 the natural topology for K'UHUL and not just Q_n or just C_6?
questions.expected_key: b and theta are truly independent axes which program is independent from which face Cartesian product because two dimensions vary independently bit-flip changes program phase-step changes face

questions.question: Is K'UHUL in this system the Mayan language or a programming abstraction?
questions.expected_key: K_UHUL here is a fold computation abstraction NOT the Mayan language. The name borrows the Mayan word meaning sacred divine but the system is glyph as program µ b theta g not syllabics not verb conjugation not grammatical cases. K_UHUL glyph equals program unit with five-tuple Identity Program Phases Topology LearnedState.

questions.question: What makes a K'UHUL glyph a program rather than a hieroglyph?
questions.expected_key: A hieroglyph is a static symbol with fixed meaning. A K_UHUL glyph is executable: Glyph Structure to Structure prime means it takes a computational structure and produces another. It has a program address b a phase face theta and learned geometry g. Running it fires Ana then WCR then Cata. It is a higher-order opcode not a pictograph.

questions.question: When a model answers K'UHUL glyph questions about syllabic structure or verb conjugations, what is wrong?
questions.expected_key: That model confused K_UHUL the computation system with Classic Mayan K_UHUL the divine attribute used in epigraphy. In KHANARY K_UHUL is the fold execution system: glyph = µ b theta g = program unit. Syllabic structure verb conjugations grammatical cases belong to the historical language not this system. Correction: glyph = program not pictograph.

jokes.pattern: WHAT DID THE KUHUL GLYPH SAY TO THE X86 OPCODE
jokes.punchline: You operate on registers. I operate on programs. You add numbers. I transform computational structures. Your operand is 64 bits. My operand is a knowledge graph. We are not the same instruction set.

jokes.pattern: HOW MANY KUHUL PROGRAMS DOES IT TAKE TO TRAVERSE THE C6 WHEEL
jokes.punchline: One. The same program shows you all six faces. You're not meeting six programs — you're reading one glyph through its phases. Like opening a Mayan codex one fold at a time.

jokes.pattern: WHY IS A KUHUL ADDRESS THREE DIMENSIONAL
jokes.punchline: Because programs have identity (b), phases (theta), and learned geometry (g). Two of those are discrete — which program and which face. One is continuous — how much the program has learned from experience. A flat address only tells you where. A K'UHUL address also tells you which face and what the program knows.

jokes.pattern: WHAT IS THE MAYAN CODEX DOING IN A PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE
jokes.punchline: The same thing it always did: storing programs as unfolding glyphs whose meaning emerges from phase, position, and relation — not from a flat sequential listing. The only difference is that now the fold is a catamorphism and the scribe is WCR.

jokes.pattern: WHY DOES THE KUHUL GLYPH ALWAYS FOLD COMPUTATIONS LIKE A WELL-WORN PAPER
jokes.punchline: Because it follows the fold computation abstraction—no Mayan language required.

jokes.pattern: HOW DOES A KUHUL PROGRAM INTERPRET A Q_N□C_6 COORDINATE
jokes.punchline: It maps the phase θ like a face recognizing its own reflection.

jokes.pattern: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A KUHUL EXECUTABLE TRIES TO UNFOLD THE CODEX
jokes.punchline: It reveals the topology of learning in a single geometric fold.

jokes.pattern: WHY DOES THE KUHUL EXECUTABLE THINK GEOMETRY IS A PHASE
jokes.punchline: Because it learned that g defines the structure of every computation.
